## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ba5c03fbdf8626ab6ece271b435efc4f643cb043`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #12528 (body, claim `6197415031` as revised, dev report `6199637771`, the seat's nail-3 ruling `6199696726`), PR #12561 (body, 26-file list, net diff against `main` at the head; merge-base `baab2d6ed`), and the head's check-runs read at 2026-10-15T18:51Z. No earlier contract review exists on this PR; the head was reviewed whole.

### ① Derived judgments

Public-surface changes the diff implies, each judged:

1. **`ViewTabItem.description?: string` (`@object-ui/plugin-view`) — right, additive.** Optional; the strip reads it in exactly three places: the active tab's `title` (`isActive && view.description`), a `DropdownMenuLabel` + separator at the head of the ▾ menu, and the menu itself is built only under `hasActionsMenu = isActive && dropdownHasEntry` (ViewTabBar.tsx:604, 850), so an inactive tab never draws it and the label never heads an empty menu. Absent ⇒ no `title`, no label: today's strip exactly.
2. **`ObjectGridComponentProps.onColumnSummaryChange?` (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`) — right, additive; the callback contract is sound.** `summaryFooter` is `hasSummary && onColumnSummaryChange ? <FooterSummaryReport/> : hasSummary ? <own row/> : null`, rendered at the one site the row always had (ObjectGrid.tsx:6812, 7005), so a grid with no callback draws its own `column-summary-footer` unchanged (the PR's CONTROL and the untouched `column-features` / `footerSummaryScope-12081` tests still read that row). The report is keyed on `JSON.stringify(summaries)`, so a fresh array per render sends nothing; the handler rides a ref; the unmount cleanup sends `null`, and because the reporter is mounted where the row would be, every path that withholds the row (grouped grid, loading/error face, view switch) unmounts it and reports `null`. In `ListView` the receiver is the `setGridSummaries` state setter (stable identity), the text only re-fires on content change, and `footerSummaryText` is derived, so no render loop with the list's state.
3. **`ObjectGridFooterSummary` is referenced by the published prop's signature but is NOT exported** — wrong, a gap. `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx:40` exports `ObjectGridComponentProps`, `ObjectGridExternalPaginationProps`, `ObjectGridColumnState`, `ObjectGridRowOperations` only. A host typing its own handler (as `ListView` does, by re-spelling `{ key; header; label }` inline) cannot name the element type except through `Parameters<NonNullable<ObjectGridComponentProps['onColumnSummaryChange']>>[0]`. Add it to the index export list in this PR; it costs one line and is part of the widening the changeset already declares.
4. **`ListView` with no host strip — right.** `showDescriptionInfo = !!viewDescription && schema.appearance?.showDescription !== false && !hasToolbarLeading` keeps the pre-existing gate (resolved text, `showDescription !== false`) and adds only the strip condition, so a host without `toolbarLeading` still gets the description, now as the in-row `view-description-info` control (`title` + `aria-label`); with the strip the list draws none. The retired `view-description` row has no consumer left on the head outside the files the diff already updates (grep over the whole tree, docs and e2e included: none); `sort-relational-hint` likewise. `list.sortRelationalHint` survives as the info control's text, so `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`'s sentinel still resolves.
5. **ObjectView fills `description` with the relay's gate and resolver — right.** `(view.showDescription ?? view.appearance?.showDescription) === false ? undefined : pickLocalized(view.description, displayLocale) || undefined` (ObjectView.tsx:3277) has the same precedence as the `appearance` relay at 3660–3667 (bare `showDescription` folded over `appearance.showDescription`), and `views` and `viewDef = activeView` are the same resolved view objects, so `showDescription: false` ⇒ shown nowhere (no tab title, no menu label, and `ListView` draws no info control because the strip is present). Same `pickLocalized` on `useDisplayLocale()` that `ListView` uses. Page-level pin in `ObjectView.refreshInPlace-10035` covers both halves.
6. **`list.sortRelationalPicked` — right.** Present in all ten packs on the head (`ar de en es fr ja ko pt ru zh`; the only other files under `locales/` are `index.ts`, `registry.ts`, `rtl.ts`) and in `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`; `check:i18n-keys` / `check:i18n-drift` are green in the `Repo Gates` check. Drawn only while `sortPicksRelationalField` (a relational field already in `currentSort`), which is the one-line condition the card asked for.
7. **Nail 4 on the list side — right in code, but its pin is red on this head (see ③).** `recordCountShown || footerSummaryText` draws the row for either half; the count span and the cap warning are both gated on `recordCountShown`, so `showRecordCount: false` keeps the summaries and drops the count, as the PR says. Behaviour change worth stating: with the callback passed and `showRecordCount: false`, summaries now appear in the list's footer row where before they sat in the grid's own row; the changeset says so.
8. **Docs owed under AGENTS.md #2 — owed on THIS PR, not a follow-up.** Rule #2 ("Docs-driven … Not done until docs reflect the code") binds the PR, not the order's file surface. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` (Column Summaries) does not mention `onColumnSummaryChange`, and `packages/plugin-view/README.md`'s `ViewTabItem` entry does not mention `description`. Two short paragraphs; carry them in this PR with the fix in ③.

### ② Semver level

Matches. `.changeset/12528-list-dashboard-chrome.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-view` **minor** (new optional `ViewTabItem.description`), `@object-ui/plugin-grid` **minor** (new optional `onColumnSummaryChange` and the `ObjectGridFooterSummary` shape), `@object-ui/plugin-list` patch (no `ListViewProps` change; the `toolbarLeading` doc comment widened, test ids moved), `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch (one additive key). Never major; `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Claim Re-read` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are all green on the head. The `Clause-②:` line reads `yes (widening)` in the changeset, the PR body and the revised claim `6197415031`, naming the same two members — consistent with the diff. (Export the element type too, ① item 3; it is covered by the same minor.)

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Gate verdict on the head: `Test (shard 4/16)` FAILURE, and the aggregate `Test` check FAILURE through it** (run 38786550136; the only failing suite on the head). The failing file is this PR's own pin `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.footerOneRow-12528.test.tsx` > "draws the count at the left and the summaries at the right of the same row": `Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="record-count-summaries"]` with the bar holding only `9 records`. Diagnosis from the diff: `ListView` mounts the view component (here the `GridProbe` registered as `object-grid`) only after the fetch settles (ListView.tsx:5825–5846 skeleton/empty faces first), i.e. in the SAME commit that draws `record-count-bar`. The probe reports from a passive `useEffect`, which React schedules as a separate task after that commit. The test awaits `findByTestId('record-count-bar')` and `waitFor(... '9 records')`, both satisfied by that commit, then reads `record-count-summaries` **synchronously** (line 100). Whether the probe's effect and the `setGridSummaries` re-render have flushed by then is a scheduler race, so the pin passes on a quiet machine (the dev's 290/290) and fails under CI load (shard duration 399 s). The CONTROL test has the mirror flaw: `queryByTestId(...)` being `null` is satisfied vacuously before the probe reports. Fix: `await within(bar).findByTestId('record-count-summaries')` (or `waitFor`) for the first assertion, and in the CONTROL assert after the probe has reported (e.g. a spy on the callback, or `await waitFor(() => expect(reported-call).toHaveBeenCalled())` before the null check). Code under test is not implicated — the grid-side pin passed and the list half is a pure derivation of state — but a red pin on the head is a red gate, and the pin as written would stay flaky after merge.
- **Nail 3 deferred** — answered by the seat's ruling `6199696726` (option A, second PR on the card carrying `Fixes #12528`; this PR stays `Part of #12528`). Nothing in this diff touches `plugin-dashboard`. Closed.
- **`packages/app-shell/` vitest NOT MEASURED locally** — covered on the head by CI: the two touched app-shell tests (`ObjectView.refreshInPlace-10035`, `ObjectView.externalRefreshSum-10572`) ran inside the 16-shard full battery, and every shard except 4/16 (the plugin-list pin above) is green; `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Repo Gates`, `Build Docs`, `Bundle Analysis`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Spec Main Shape Gate` all success. Closed by CI.
- **Final-head pins re-run NOT MEASURED locally** — the same CI run is at the final head `ba5c03fbd` (post second merge of `origin/main`, carrying #12537's `ViewTabBar` host-width change), and it is exactly that run that turned the one pin red. So this deviation is answered, and the answer is the failure above. The dev's note that "the merge changed none of this branch's files" is correct for the diff; the red pin is a timing flaw in the test, not a merge artefact.
- **Docs** (AGENTS.md #2) — owed on this PR; see ① item 8. Not escalated: the seat's file surface does not override the repo rule, and the cost is two paragraphs.
- Serial note confirmed from the diff: this branch's `ViewTabBar.tsx` edit is confined to the `description` field, the active tab's `title` and the ▾ menu header; it merged cleanly over #12537.

Required before a PASS on a new head: (1) make `ListView.footerOneRow-12528.test.tsx` await the summaries span and make its CONTROL assert after the report; (2) export `ObjectGridFooterSummary` from `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`; (3) the two doc paragraphs. A green `Test` check on that head and this record is re-rendered.
